description: This file defines a React functional component named Registration, which manages a multi-step registration form including form state, validation, and submission. It also interacts with external services and stores for registration processing.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the form state with new key-value pair.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Handles moving from step 1 to step 2 after simple validation and setting OTP context.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of registration data, sets loading state, calls API, and updates result state.
